+3V3 source is the main supply rail; KiCad ERC is clean.
VBAT is the external/battery input rail; KiCad ERC is clean.

mating_design.name: BitPresTagBMP581 self-contained board
mating_design.source: Inferred from BitPresTagBMP581 schematic and similar to PresTag design.
notes: This is a self-contained STM32L432-based pressure sensing tag.
Features BMP581 pressure sensor and RV-3028-C7 RTC.
Multiple chip-select, clock, wake, reset, and power-enable nets depend on explicit STM32 reset/sleep GPIO configuration.
BMP581 1.8 V rail may be controlled by STM32 pin through LDO enable.
AT25_nCS does not have an external pull-up; firmware/internal pull configuration must keep flash deselected during reset/sleep.

host_pin_map.required_state: Input/no-pull unless actively using clock output capture.
host_pin_map.reason: Avoids fighting RTC clock output; clock net is EMC-sensitive.

host_pin_map.required_state: Analog/no-pull.
External reset network controls state.
host_pin_map.reason: Verify Q501 reset-drive polarity during programming and sleep.

host_pin_map.required_state: Pull state must match pressure sensor interrupt polarity.
host_pin_map.reason: Wake input should have a deliberate inactive state.

host_pin_map.required_state: Pull-up during reset/sleep/high-Z.
Pull-down or push-pull idle appropriate to selected bus mode.
host_pin_map.reason: Prevents floating pressure sensor data input.

host_pin_map.required_state: Pull-down or no-pull while BMP_CS is inactive.
Pull-down in reset/sleep/high-Z.
Pull-down when magnetometer rail is enabled; no-pull/high-Z if AK domain is off.
host_pin_map.reason: Prevents spurious clocks and avoids back-power risk.

host_pin_map.required_state: Pull-down or no-pull while AK_CS is inactive.
Pull-down when AK domain is enabled; no-pull/high-Z if AK domain is off.
host_pin_map.reason: Keeps magnetometer input quiet and avoids back-power risk.

host_pin_map.required_state: Hold low during reset/sleep unless magnetometer is intentionally active.
host_pin_map.reason: Keeps magnetometer reset while power domain is off or settling.

host_pin_map.required_state: Pull-up during reset/sleep/high-Z.
Analog/no-pull.
Drive low or pull-down in sleep; drive high to enable +1V8.
Input/no-pull or pull-down when powered; confirm against selected AK09940 output mode.
host_pin_map.reason: Data-ready line should not float as a wake/event source.

host_pin_map.required_state: Analog/no-pull.
Analog/no-pull.
Preserve SWD debug function or use documented debug-disable state.
Preserve SWD debug function or pull-down if debug disabled.
host_pin_map.reason: Prevents floating clock input when not debugging.

host_pin_map.reason: Keeps flash deselected; schematic has no external pull-up.

Pull-down or no-pull while AT25_nCS is high.
host_pin_map.reason: Flash SO is normally tri-stated when deselected.
